Gets the Events metrics trend for a device
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/deeptraces/:trace_id/events

Gets the Events metrics trend for a device. The event metrics include Zscaler, Hardware, Software and Network event changes.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

trace_id
string
REQUIRED

trace id

Responses
​
200
401
403
APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
Example
SCHEMA

timestamp

events

]
